LESSON: HOME ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.3: Home ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Home ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name people found at home,
2. tell the relationship between people found at home,
3. talk about work done by people found at home for appreciation,
4. appreciate the people at home for harmonious living. family members

3. talk about work done by people found at home for appreciation,

4. appreciate the people at home for harmonious living. family members
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the people at home for harmonious living. family members. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.
